source_note: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明
english_source_note: A Probabilistic Proof of the Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
callout_id: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明#9
statement_en:
Let $(X,\mathcal{A},\mu)$ be a measure space, let $T:X\to Y$ be measurable, let $T_{*}\mu$ be the pushforward measure, and let $g$ be an integrable function on $Y$. Then
$$\int_{Y}g\,d(T_{*}\mu)=\int_X g\circ T\,d\mu.$$
key_techniques: change of variables in measure theory
callout_body: 设$(X,\mathcal{A},\mu)$是一个测度空间,$T:X\to Y$是一个从$X$到集合$Y$的可测函数，$T_{*}\mu$为pushforward测度，函数$g$是$Y$上的一个可积函数，那么$$\int_{Y}g\,d(T_{*}\mu)=\int_X g\circ T\,d\mu$$
